scripts.build: pnpm run build:host && pnpm run build:client
scripts.build:host: tsc -b tsconfig.host.json && tsx scripts/generate-typert.ts && tsdown --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE host
scripts.build:client: tsc -b tsconfig.client.json && tsdown --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE client && tsx scripts/assemble-lark-package.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.host.json && tsx scripts/generate-typert.ts && tsc -b tsconfig.client.json
